column1: # - The first column is intentionally the concrete probe URL, so parsers can read it directly.
# - Active rows must be concrete HTTPS URLs; do not put wildcard URLs in active rows because curl/dig probes cannot test wildcards.
# - Active rows must not contain credentials, spaces, tabs inside fields, backslashes, or glob characters.
# - Official wildcard allowlist patterns are documented below as comments and represented by concrete plan-specific endpoints when practical.
# - Proxy/transport selection must not change the official endpoint; it only changes how the container reaches it.
# - Expected HTTP values are for unauthenticated reachability probes. 400/401/403/404/405 may still mean DNS/TCP/TLS/HTTP reached the service.
# - 403/429 are accepted for selected GitHub REST API probes because rate limits and forbidden unauthenticated access are reachability-positive states.
# - _ping rows are diagnostic rows used to prove transport reachability; they are not substitutes for authenticated Copilot functionality.
# Official public Copilot allowlist patterns intentionally NOT active as wildcard probe rows:
# Copilot cloud agent / private-runner allowlist entries represented below when concrete and useful:
# Deliberately excluded from active probe rows:
# - Package registries, certificate authority CRL/OCSP hosts, container registries and operating-system mirrors from the Copilot cloud agent firewall list.
#   They are important for GitHub-hosted/cloud-agent build environments, but this registry governs GitHub/Copilot transport inside the DevContainer.
# - GHE.com placeholders and enterprise-specific SUBDOMAIN values; add them only through an explicit local overlay/override.
# - Azure report fallback wildcards and blob wildcards; keep them in firewall allowlists, not as active curl/dig probe rows, unless a concrete tenant URL is known.
